hooks.command: PLAN_DIR=$(grep -oP 'path: \K[^|]+' ~/.claude-kit/plans/.active 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' '); if [ -n "$PLAN_DIR" ] && [ -f "$PLAN_DIR/status.md" ]; then MODE=$(grep -oP 'mode: \K\S+' "$PLAN_DIR/status.md" 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown'); echo '[spec] Active plan detected (mode: '"$MODE"'). BOOT SEQUENCE: Read '"$PLAN_DIR"'/status.md to resume.'; head -10 "$PLAN_DIR/status.md"; elif [ -n "$PLAN_DIR" ] && [ -f "$PLAN_DIR/plan.md" ]; then echo '[spec] Active plan detected. Read '"$PLAN_DIR"'/plan.md to resume.'; head -5 "$PLAN_DIR/plan.md"; else echo '[spec] Check TaskList for PLAN-ACTIVE item to find your plan.'; fi
hooks.description: Nudge Claude to read plan files after context compaction

hooks.command: if [ -d ~/.claude-kit/plans/ ]; then LATEST=$(ls -t ~/.claude-kit/plans/ 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$LATEST" ]; then if [ -f ~/.claude-kit/plans/$LATEST/status.md ]; then echo "[spec] Recent plan: $LATEST"; head -6 ~/.claude-kit/plans/$LATEST/status.md; elif [ -f ~/.claude-kit/plans/$LATEST/plan.md ]; then echo "[spec] Recent plan: $LATEST"; head -4 ~/.claude-kit/plans/$LATEST/plan.md; fi; else echo '[spec] No plans found. Use /spec:new to create one.'; fi; else echo '[spec] No plans found. Use /spec:new to create one.'; fi
hooks.description: Show recent plan activity on session start/resume
